name: Spiekeroog (Germany)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a blue disc bearing a yellow sailing ship, between the white inscriptions NORDSEEHEILBAD above and SPIEKEROOG below.
history: Municipal flag of Spiekeroog; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: disc with a yellow sailing ship
